key.name: github-token
key.description: Fine-grained or classic PAT. Needs at least "notifications" read access for mentions/review requests, and "public_repo" (or repo) read access if you watch private repos for issues/PRs/stars.

key.name: github-host
key.description: Host for API, e.g. api.github.com or github.example.com for Enterprise (uses /api/v3).

key.name: watched-repos
key.description: Repos to poll for new issues, new pull requests and new stars, e.g. "gnome/gnome-shell,torvalds/linux"

key.name: watch-mentions
key.summary: Poll /notifications for mentions and review requests

key.name: watch-issues-prs
key.summary: Poll watched repos for new issues and PRs

key.name: watch-stars
key.summary: Poll watched repos for new stars

key.name: hide-when-empty
key.summary: Hide the panel icon when there is nothing unread

key.name: last-state
key.summary: Internal JSON blob tracking last-seen ids/counts

key.name: link-behavior
key.description: Browser tab or Web app window (requires Chromium-based browser).

key.name: icon-always-unlit
key.description: Leave the Octocat dim even when notifications are waiting.
